title: Call and He Will Answer
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who asks instead of guessing, and tonight’s story is Heavenly Father saying “Call unto me”: Jeremiah calls from behind the prison walls and is promised an answer, the way Scout asked Poppa Allen about the moon and found that asking opens the door to wonder.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because asking is how he finds things out, and this story is Heavenly Father saying, “Call unto me.” In Scout’s world today: he wonders why the moon seems to follow the car. He does not just guess and give up. He asks Poppa Allen at dinner, and the answer makes Scout’s mouth fall open. Just like Jeremiah being promised great things if he would call, Scout learned that asking opens the door to wonder.
